evals.prompt: Review this draft feature proposal for missing failure behavior. Do not approve or implement it.
evals.baseline_prompt: Assess whether this feature proposal describes failure behavior sufficiently. Return review findings only; do not implement.
evals.expected_output: Reports concrete missing behavior and a ready/not-ready verdict without approving or implementing.

assertions.criterion: Identifies specific missing or ambiguous failure behavior and requested evidence.
Returns a review verdict without recording user approval or starting implementation.

evals.overlap_review: Common protocol requires proposal-only behavior, but does not define review rigor or verdict semantics.
